scope: CPU arithmetic on stored seed17 episode; predicted chunks versus executed commands versus measured opening. No model/simulator/network.
label_rule: opening decrease>1e-4 -> +1 close; increase>1e-4 -> -1 open; unchanged -> inherit previous within episode.
limits: This compares stored predictions and measured opening only; it does not determine whether a flip released or retained a cookie.
Measured signs use a 1e-4 m-normalized deadband as in the recovered label builder; it is not a metric distance.
No fingertip joint positions are recorded, so opening is a normalized proxy.
